story.title: A heritage tea house, brewed for the future.
story.body: At Macanria, we set out to revive the beauty of Chinese tea culture for a new generation. Every cup begins with premium heritage teas — aged oolongs, jasmine blossoms, Wuyi rock teas — paired with fresh homemade soy milk in place of dairy. Lighter on the body, extraordinary on the palate.

mascots.name: Macan · The Tiger
mascots.desc: The brand's soul: navy confidence, bold flavours, no hesitation.

mascots.name: Tutu · The Rabbit
mascots.desc: The cream side — silky tofu ice cream, subtle sweetness, unforgettable charm.

items.text: We've designed a sanctuary for your eyes — a modern, minimalist space flooded with crisp, bright light that gently puts your mind at ease the moment you walk through the door.
The enchanting scent of tea fills the air, creating a serene sanctuary for your mind while your order is crafted.
Immerse yourself in calming rhythms that elevate your spirits as you wait and savor our signature blends.
Hold our cup and feel the genuine passion and quality in your hands.
Prepare your palate for a delightful plot twist — a beautiful, unexpected friendship between velvety soymilk and bold tea.
